changes.title: Flying squirrel
items: A new animal for a later island: the flying squirrel of the Mistwood, a misty old-growth forest of giant spruce, cedar and tree ferns with a nurse log in its clearing
Flying squirrels glide from spot to spot through the trees, and swoop in on a glide when they fight
Its legend's gliding skin is a starry night sky; at peace it gives Glide: a little quicker over the treetops and a longer blink

changes.title: Roe deer
items: A new animal: the roe deer, small and quick, all ears and eyes, living in a new kind of place, the mossy dell (rowan, birch and oak over deep moss and ferns), on an island far to the north-west
Its legend's gift, Spring: your dodge comes back sooner

changes.title: Beach pixels
items: The beach's sand is pixelated like everything else now, chunky and grainy instead of smooth
